nodes.label: graphify Full Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Multi-step pipeline design (detect → extract → build → cluster → label → export) ensures separation of concerns: AST and semantic extraction can run in parallel, caching avoids redundant LLM calls, and incremental updates (--update) avoid reprocessing unchanged files.

nodes.label: AST Structural Extraction
nodes.rationale: Deterministic AST extraction runs in parallel with semantic subagents since they operate on different file types, saving 5-15s on large corpora.

nodes.label: Constrained Query Vocab Expansion
nodes.rationale: graphify's query CLI has no stemming or synonyms — vocab expansion against actual graph node labels prevents zero-hit query collapses when user language differs from graph vocabulary.

nodes.label: Semantic Extraction Cache
nodes.rationale: Cache avoids redundant LLM subagent calls on unchanged files, reducing token cost and latency on incremental runs.

nodes.label: Watch Mode (Auto-Rebuild)
nodes.rationale: Code-only changes trigger immediate AST re-extraction without LLM; doc/image changes write a needs_update flag because they require semantic (LLM) extraction.

nodes.label: Villa Luar Property
nodes.rationale: 5-bed luxury villa in Playa Blanca, Lanzarote; 350m²; 10% net yield; managed by Jet2/Solmar Villas. The Jet2/Solmar contract until Jan 2027 removes management overhead entirely, making it attractive to UK buyers who fear overseas property hassle.

nodes.label: UK Investment Buyer (Target Audience)
nodes.rationale: UK buy-to-let yields of 4-6% are unattractive versus 10% net yield; Section 24 and stamp duty surcharges have driven UK landlords to consider overseas alternatives. The Jet2/Solmar contract addresses the primary pain point of overseas management.

nodes.label: Break Clause Deadline Urgency (June 2026)
nodes.rationale: Genuine (not manufactured) urgency: new owner must exercise break clause before end of June 2026 to retain flexibility on the Jet2 contract. Used as urgency hook from Week 4 onward.

nodes.label: Multi-Channel Campaign Strategy
nodes.rationale: Organic-only (no paid ads) strategy uses villaluar.com as the hub with all channels driving to it; portals, Facebook groups, YouTube, Reddit, and personal network run in parallel to maximize reach without advertising spend.

nodes.label: Villa Luar React Application
nodes.rationale: React + Vite chosen for static output deployable to Cloudflare Pages/Workers without server infrastructure; Gemini API used for AI-powered image descriptions and buyer chatbot.

nodes.label: Villa Luar CMS (Admin Panel)
nodes.rationale: CMS workflow uses local /admin panel + 'Download Content File' to update villa-content.json, then push to GitHub for Cloudflare auto-rebuild — avoids need for a backend database or CMS API.

nodes.label: Villa Luar SEO & Schema.org RealEstateListing
nodes.rationale: Schema.org RealEstateListing markup enables Google rich results for property search; OG and Twitter Card meta tags ensure attractive social shares on WhatsApp/Facebook/LinkedIn which are primary campaign channels.
